r4.2.name: CMU CERT r4.2
r4.2.fullName: CMU CERT Insider Threat Testbed Release 4.2
r4.2.description: Synthetic multi-source enterprise log stream generated by ExactData LLC & CMU SEI covering 17 continuous months across 1,000 corporate employees.

raw_tables.name: logon.csv
raw_tables.desc: Logon and logoff timestamps across user workstations.

raw_tables.name: device.csv
raw_tables.desc: Thumb drive mounts and disconnect timestamps.

raw_tables.name: file.csv
raw_tables.desc: File writes, reads, and transfers to removable media.

raw_tables.name: email.csv
raw_tables.desc: Outbound and internal emails with recipient and attachment counts.

raw_tables.name: http.csv
raw_tables.desc: Web access logs with upload URLs, content length, and depth.

raw_tables.name: psychometric.csv
raw_tables.desc: Five-Factor (OCEAN) personality traits for all employees.

raw_tables.name: LDAP/ (Monthly)
raw_tables.desc: Monthly corporate directory snapshot tracking roles, supervisors, and departures.

methodology.cv: 5-Fold Stratified Cross-Validation (K=5) for tuning and Out-Of-Fold probability generation
methodology.feature_selection: Two-stage ANOVA F-Test + Mutual Information ranking (Top-50 features selected strictly on train split)
methodology.imbalance_treatment: Cost-Sensitive class weighting (balanced_subsample, scale_pos_weight) vs. Fold-Level SMOTE + Random Undersampling

overall_champion.name: Stacking Ensemble
overall_champion.reason: Combines Random Forest, XGBoost, and CatBoost via optimal soft-voting to reach 91.26% precision, 84.30% recall, and 87.65% F1-score with only 18 false alarms across 94,123 sessions.

precision_champion.name: XGBoost
precision_champion.reason: Delivers 92.54% precision with only 15 false alarms out of 93,900 benign sessions (FPR = 0.0160%).

sensitivity_champion.name: Stacking Ensemble
sensitivity_champion.reason: Intercepted 188 out of 223 insider threat sessions across all three test scenarios.

scenarios.name: Off-Hours USB Data Theft
scenarios.desc: System administrator logs on during off-hours, connects external USB drive, and exfiltrates proprietary code.

scenarios.name: Data Sabotage / Logic Bomb
scenarios.desc: Disgruntled developer deploys unauthorized scripts and accesses unauthorized customer databases.

scenarios.name: Keylogger Deployment & Disgruntled Exfiltration
scenarios.desc: Employee emails confidential documents to competitor webmail domains after critical performance review.

r5.2.name: CMU CERT r5.2
r5.2.fullName: CMU CERT Insider Threat Testbed Release 5.2
r5.2.description: Multi-scenario synthetic benchmark covering 18 continuous months (75 calendar weeks) across 2,000 corporate employees and 99 ground-truth threat actors.

raw_tables.name: logon.csv
raw_tables.desc: User authentication events, machine IDs, and logon/logoff times.

raw_tables.name: device.csv
raw_tables.desc: USB storage insertion and removal activity.

raw_tables.name: file.csv
raw_tables.desc: File reads, writes, and transfers across corporate workstations.

raw_tables.name: email.csv
raw_tables.desc: Corporate email traffic including size, recipients, and attachments.

raw_tables.name: http.csv
raw_tables.desc: Web browsing logs, upload requests, URL depth, and payload bytes.

raw_tables.name: psychometric.csv
raw_tables.desc: Five-Factor (OCEAN) psychometric assessments for 2,000 employees.

raw_tables.name: LDAP/ (Monthly)
raw_tables.desc: Monthly organization chart tracking department moves and terminations.

methodology.cv: 5-Fold Stratified Cross-Validation (K=5) for hyperparameter tuning and out-of-fold meta-features
methodology.feature_selection: ANOVA F-Test + Mutual Information Top-50 discriminative behavioral indicators
methodology.imbalance_treatment: Cost-Sensitive class weighting (balanced_subsample, scale_pos_weight=1.0) vs. Fold-Level SMOTE + Random Undersampling

overall_champion.name: Stacking Ensemble
overall_champion.reason: Outperforms every single base model with 79.28% precision, 77.78% recall, and 78.52% F1 on 200,892 test sessions, capturing 287 out of 369 threat sessions.

precision_champion.name: XGBoost
precision_champion.reason: Yields 82.46% precision and 57 false alarms out of 200,523 normal sessions (FPR = 0.0284%).

sensitivity_champion.name: Stacking Ensemble
sensitivity_champion.reason: Intercepted 287 threat sessions across Scenarios 1–4, beating RF (235), XGB (268), and CatBoost (276).

scenarios.name: USB Flash Drive Exfiltration
scenarios.desc: After-hours workstation login followed by unauthorized bulk file copying to thumb drives.

scenarios.name: Privileged Sabotage / Logic Bomb
scenarios.desc: Privileged administrator planting malicious scripts and executing destructive administrative commands.

scenarios.name: Keylogger Deployment & Disgruntled Email
scenarios.desc: Disgruntled employee installing keylogger and emailing trade secrets to personal accounts.

scenarios.name: Flight Risk Job Hunting & Exfiltration
scenarios.desc: Employee actively searching competitor job sites and downloading IP before departure.

r6.2.name: CMU CERT r6.2
r6.2.fullName: CMU CERT Insider Threat Testbed Release 6.2
r6.2.description: Enterprise-scale testbed spanning 18 continuous months (75 calendar weeks) across 4,000 corporate employees, featuring ~100 GB of raw logs and an extreme 20,515:1 needle-in-a-haystack class imbalance.

engineering.peak_memory_ram: 980 MB (<1.0 GB RAM constraint strictly maintained)

raw_tables.name: logon.csv
raw_tables.desc: Authentication events across 4,000 employees and workstations.

raw_tables.name: device.csv
raw_tables.desc: Removable USB drive attachments and session durations.

raw_tables.name: file.csv
raw_tables.desc: File writes, reads, and transfers to external media.

raw_tables.name: email.csv
raw_tables.desc: Outbound and internal employee email traffic.

raw_tables.name: http.csv
raw_tables.desc: Massive web browsing logs with upload requests, cloud URLs, and depths.

raw_tables.name: psychometric.csv
raw_tables.desc: Five-Factor (OCEAN) psychometric scores for all 4,000 personnel.

raw_tables.name: LDAP/ (Monthly)
raw_tables.desc: Monthly corporate hierarchy snapshot tracking promotions, teams, and terminations.

methodology.cv: 5-Fold Stratified Cross-Validation (K=5) with 50-round early stopping on validation PR-AUC
methodology.feature_selection: Two-stage ANOVA F-Score + Mutual Information Top-50 discriminative behavioral indicators
methodology.imbalance_treatment: Cost-Sensitive class weighting (scale_pos_weight=25.0) vs. Fold-Level SMOTE + Random Undersampling

overall_champion.name: Stacking Ensemble
overall_champion.reason: Delivers the highest PR-AUC on the 389,817-session test set (0.3322), 50.0% precision, 35.29% F1-score, and suppresses 97% of CatBoost's false alarms down to just 6 false alarms (FPR = 0.00154%).

precision_champion.name: Random Forest
precision_champion.reason: Yields 50.0% precision with only 4 false alarms across 389,795 benign sessions (FPR = 0.00103%).

sensitivity_champion.name: CatBoost
sensitivity_champion.reason: Catches 54.55% of all malicious sessions, intercepts 90% of Scenario 2 USB sabotage, and is the sole model to detect Scenario 3 keylogger exfiltration.

scenarios.name: IP / Code Exfiltration to USB
scenarios.desc: System administrator accesses proprietary source repositories and writes files to thumb drive.

scenarios.name: Sabotage / Destructive USB Flash Drive Leak
scenarios.desc: Privileged operator copies files to external drives and executes unauthorized system alterations.

scenarios.name: Keylogger Deployment & Disgruntled Exfiltration
scenarios.desc: Employee installs malicious software and transmits logs outside organizational boundaries.

scenarios.name: Flight Risk Job-Hunting Exfiltration
scenarios.desc: Employee searches competitor portals, visits job boards, and downloads confidential project docs before resigning.

scenarios.name: Dropbox Cloud Storage Exfiltration (Zero-Shot)
scenarios.desc: Employee uploads corporate assets directly to personal Dropbox cloud storage via web portal.
